messages:
linda: Hey — dashboard alert: tenant 'acme-corp' shows traces from 'homecare-inc'. Looks like context bleed in routing/telemetry. Anyone else?

raj: yep saw that at 15:03, traced to metrics ingestion pipeline? but raw logs show correct tenant id upstream.

sam: I think it's the internal routing policy change from last deploy — we changed header fallback from X-RW-TENANT -> X-RW-ORG in the gateway. If gateway drops header, downstream uses session namespace param.

marta: Repro steps: curl to /console/api/metrics with X-RW-TENANT=acme-corp and session cookie for homecare-inc => backend logs tenant=homecare-inc but telemetry recorded acme-corp. Attaching logs snippet below.

ops-bot: alert: deploy 2026-03-20T14:55 (deploy-bot) completed on gateway v2.3.1

raj: giving quick log snippet:
```
INFO incoming headers: X-RW-TENANT: acme-corp
INFO session.namespace: homecare-inc
WARNING telemetry.namespace: acme-corp
```
Looks like telemetry采集 picks header before session auth merges.

sam: Working theory: router proxies set telemetry_context from request.headers at proxy layer; later auth middleware overrides ctx.namespace but telemetry uses the earlier cached reference.

linda: Is this exploitable? Could an org see another org's dashboards?

marta: Potentially yes for overlapping read operations — not writes. Need to treat as P1.

sam: Quick mitigation: flip gateway to preserve auth-first canonicalization. PR ready: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/PR-3129
Patch changes order: auth -> set namespace -> telemetry attach.

raj: Can we canary to dedicated region? Or revert gateway deploy?

linda: Revert for now. Rolling back gateway to v2.3.0 in prod. @deploy-bot please start rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: rollback deploy 1704512450 -> v2.3.0. ETA ~7m.

ops-bot: Rolling back metrics ingestion consumer in eu-west-1 too.

marta: We'll follow up with postmortem and add an integration test for header/session precedence. I'll open a ticket with repro and suggested unit tests.

sam: Also adding a telemetry lint that rejects using stale ctx references.

linda: Thanks. Keep thread updated with rollback status and any customer contact. :thumbsup:

raj: rollback done, metrics look back to expected. last bad sample timestamp: 1704512360

marta: Created ticket: TI-987 - telemetry namespace shadowing. Assigned to platform.

linda: closing here, move discussion to TI-987 and link PR when merged.
